title: Iraola admits Liverpool does not maintain desired level after losing a two‑goal advantage
seoTitle: Iraola: Liverpool fails to sustain desired level
subtitle: Coach acknowledges a dip in performance over two consecutive matches
excerpt: Andoni Iraola acknowledges Liverpool squandered a two‑goal lead in back‑to‑back games and says the side cannot sustain the required level.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Declining performance at Liverpool

Andoni Iraola noted that Liverpool saw a two‑goal advantage overturned in two consecutive matches. The coach pointed out that, despite the early lead, the squad failed to maintain the necessary tempo to secure the win.

The pattern of losing the lead after scoring two goals raises questions about the consistency of the collective performance. Iraola indicated that the issue lies in the inability to sustain the level the club aspires to, suggesting there are gaps that need to be filled to avoid similar recurrences.

Analyzing the situation, the manager emphasized the need for adjustments that allow the team to preserve the advantage gained during the match. The core message conveyed by Iraola stresses that maintaining a high standard is essential for Liverpool to achieve the objectives set throughout the competition.

With information from BBC Sport.
